True def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A solid line separates two panels. Keep the cells occupied in both.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1:
            a, b = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            n = min(len(a), len(b))
            return [[2 if a[i][j] != 0 and b[i][j] != 0 else 0
                     for j in range(w)] for i in range(n)]
    for c in range(w):
        if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1:
            a = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            b = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            n = min(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
            return [[2 if a[i][j] != 0 and b[i][j] != 0 else 0
                     for j in range(n)] for i in range(h)]
    raise ValueError("No solid separator found")
